areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Directly aligned: road requalification and urban drainage; objectives, indicators, components and resources relevant; proponent did not clarify whether impacts are structuring or transformative.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Relevant objectives and indicators, but only a very small share of resources is allocated, which drives the lowest level and impact.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Related objectives, high impact and efficient measures; no dedicated components, only products on disaster prevention and slope recovery.

areas.name: Tourism
areas.reason: Relevant objectives, indicators and targets on urban services oriented to tourism, but only a small resource share, giving lowest level and impact.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: Relevant objectives and innovative digital public services, but only a small resource share, so lowest level and impact.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: Municipal institutional strengthening is relevant but its effects are indirect and fit better under digital government; no indicators or targets showing direct contribution.

not_accepted.name: State capacity
not_accepted.reason: Municipal institutional strengthening is relevant but its effects are indirect and fit better under digital government; no indicators or targets showing direct contribution.

bonus.reason: Proponent cited the Annex II strategic areas as priorities rather than those listed in art. 15 par.3, so the additional point was precluded.
Proponent is not located in the border strip, so the criterion is not met.
